notes:
- Copied a screenshot? With the editor empty, VeilShot offers "Open the copied image". It only
  checks that an image is there; the image itself is read when you click or paste.
- Finds API keys the way people write them, such as Stripe-style keys and "API key:" labels,
  and hides only the secret, not the label beside it.
- Hiding an email now covers just the address, not the whole line around it.
- What you see is what leaves: the canvas shows the real effect (solid, blur, pixelate and the
  rest) exactly as the exported copy will have it.
- Hide uses the effect you picked and selects the new areas, so you can adjust them straight
  away.
- The detect button now says "Find sensitive content".
- The review dialog fits the smallest window, and the panel behind it stays still.
